_comment: MACHINE-READABLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the DMV up-front-money figures. This is the structured twin of the table in jurisdiction-deposits.md. When a figure changes, change it HERE (and in the prose table), and the Plain Sight rights page picks it up at build time via scripts/sync-law-data.mjs. Keep the two in sync. Not legal advice; every figure carries the collection date in asOf.

DC.name: Washington DC
DC.depositLine: In DC the security deposit is capped at one month’s rent, and money held as “last month’s rent” still counts toward that cap.

applicationFee.note: Must refund an unused or never-run application fee within 14 days.

MD.name: Maryland
MD.depositLine: In Maryland the security deposit is capped at one month’s rent for leases on or after Oct 1, 2024 (older leases may still carry up to two months), and last month’s rent paid in advance counts as a deposit.

applicationFee.note: Screening fee capped at $25 for landlords with 5+ units; must be waived if given a recent screening report.

MD.rentStabilization: Montgomery and Prince George’s County cap annual increases; no statewide cap.

VA.name: Virginia
VA.depositLine: In Virginia the deposit can be up to two months’ rent, and a landlord may also require last month’s rent on top — this is the one place the big move-in stack is legal, so it’s used as a wealth screen.

prepaidRent.note: No cap on prepaid rent, but it must be placed in escrow within 5 days.
